options: Build `new Map(customers.map(c => [c.id, c]))` once, then look up each order with `map.get` — O(n + m) instead of O(n·m)
Replace `map` with a `for` loop — loops are faster than `map`
Sort `customers` by id first so `find` stops earlier
mcq.explanation: The cost is the nested scan: every order scans the customer list. One pass to build a Map makes each lookup O(1). Swapping `map` for a loop or `find` for `filter` changes constants, not the complexity.
